objective: Test the feasibility of recovering fit covariance from original public transit timings
dataset: ExoClock DRD OSF 10.17605/OSF.IO/WPJTN, per-planet mid_time_data archive
target_selection: Use all five first-horizon paper rows passing only under the zero-covariance scenario; do not replace thin targets after seeing results
split: Pre-2460000.5 BJD TDB for fit; later observed epochs for verification. Timing catalogue release is post hoc; report retrospective only. Use a frozen early ephemeris for epoch assignment if the raw file has no explicit epoch
control: Equal-data weighted least squares. Compare the same fitted center with and without the fitted covariance; measurement errors enter both forecast bands
scope: A readiness pilot may verify recoverable data, correlation and held observation coverage, with no claim of scheduling, external custody, prospective timing, or invention compounding.
